content.short: African money app for free transfers home, virtual Visa cards and US stock investing.
content.description: Chipper Cash serves more than 5 million users, sending money to bank and mobile money accounts in over 21 African countries without fees. Its virtual Visa card, with over a million issued, lets users pay for subscriptions and shopping abroad, and the app offers investing in more than 6,000 US public companies. It handles around 250,000 transactions a day and also offers crypto.
content.meta: Send money free to 21+ African countries, spend with a virtual Visa and invest in US stocks with Chipper Cash.
